properties.name: A refusal names what would have worked — a rejected argument comes back with its legal values, not just a verdict
properties.statement:
WHEN A SERVED TOOL REFUSES AN ARGUMENT BECAUSE IT IS NOT ONE OF A FIXED SET, THE REFUSAL NAMES THE SET. The caller should not have to make a second call to learn what would have worked.

THE GAP THIS CLOSES. `parse_enum` — the single helper every enum argument on the served surface passes through — refused with `unknown change type: "correction"` and nothing else. No enumeration, no nearest match, no pointer to `describe_schema`. The caller is usually an AGENT MID-TASK, for whom a refusal that does not say what would have worked costs a whole round trip and a context switch into schema reading.

⭐ THE VALUES WERE NEVER UNAVAILABLE, WHICH IS WHAT MAKES THIS A DEFECT RATHER THAN A FEATURE REQUEST. serde already builds `unknown variant `correction`, expected one of `requirement_creep`, `new_feature`, …` and the helper was DISCARDING it with `map_err(|_| …)`. The answer was constructed and thrown away on every rejection.

WHY THE FIX BELONGS IN THE SHARED HELPER, not at the call site that was reported: a hand-maintained list per tool rots the first time a variant is added, and one function serves every enum argument reflow2 exposes. Fixing it there means every refusal gains the list at once — which is what the reporter meant by \"this alone kills three of the eight\".

EVIDENCE. Filed by dev_storyflow 2026-08-03 (api-boss): \"enum rejections should list the legal values… this alone kills three of the eight.\" RE-CONFIRMED STILL LIVE 2026-08-09 by dragon Boss (`cca98fbf`), who recorded the cost precisely: \"one wasted call, then describe_schema{node_type: ChangeEvent, required_only: true} to learn the 11 legal values.\" And reproduced a third time the same day by a session in THIS repo while recording a correction — which is how it came to be fixed.

WHAT THIS REQUIREMENT DOES NOT SAY, so the scope is not read wider than it is: it does not ask for fuzzy nearest-match suggestions, and it does not ask that every refusal of any kind enumerate an alternative — only that a CLOSED SET, which the surface already knows, is stated rather than withheld. Where the message shape is unrecognised, the honest fallback is the underlying error's own words rather than a silent return to the bare verdict.

⚠️ A SEPARATE AND UNRESOLVED HALF, recorded here so it is not mistaken for closed: dragon Boss's second point was that NONE of the eleven legal `change_type` values means \"the record was WRONG about reality\". `resync` connotes reality moving and the design catching up. Adding a value would move the schema stamp and is Anthony's call; this requirement is only about the refusal being useful, not about the vocabulary being complete.
